name: Cooperative Home Care Associates
description: A worker-owned home care agency in the South Bronx, New York, and by most accounts the largest worker cooperative in the United States, employing roughly 2,000 workers, most of them women of color. Employees can buy an ownership stake through small payroll deductions; worker-owners elect a majority of the board and receive profit-based dividends. A member of the U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives and frequently cited as a model for scaling worker ownership in low-wage industries.
